events.quote: 1. Start every sentence with a capital letter. 2. Write 'I' as a capital letter always. 3. End every sentence with a full stop (.).
Rule: start each sentence with a capital letter and end it with a full stop.

The rule: for a finished past action, add -ed to a regular verb.
Right: He climbed the hill. Wrong: He climb the hill last week.
Rule: for many action words, add -ed to show a finished action.
